s: January 23, 2024 - Part of a seller’s job is to evaluate horses to determine which sales would be best for them. Most racehorses that sell at auction are weanlings, yearlings or unraced 2-year-olds. Because each step up in age requires more training, feeding and development, buyers expect to pay the least for weanlings, more for yearlings and even more for 2-year-olds.
